data.narrative:
Vatn Systems is a Series A defense & security company founded by Nelson Mills, Freddie Mills, and Geoff Manchester that has raised $76.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 10 companies in the same sector at the same or adjacent stage, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $76.5M total raised as a proxy base and applies a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x, implying a valuation of $153M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M (low) to $3.0B (high). Notable peers include Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B, and Code Metal at $1.2B.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $130M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $576M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Vatn's relative maturity, unit economics, and addressable market penetration versus the peer cohort. Key variables affecting the valuation include revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and the pace of follow-on capital deployment in the defense tech sector.
